reason: The source Freebase entity conflates Terminator units. T2 identifies a T-800 destroyed at the end; T3 identifies a separately sent T-850 reprogrammed by Kate. Shared appearance/type does not establish the same individual.

sentences.text: Meanwhile, the future John Connor has sent back a reprogrammed T-800 Terminator  to protect his younger self.
The Terminator then sacrifices itself, asking Sarah to lower it into the steel so that its technology cannot be used to create Skynet.

sentences.text: The Resistance sends a reprogrammed T-850 model 101 Terminator  back in time to protect the T-X's targets, including Kate Brewster  and John.
The Terminator reveals that, in the future, John and Kate had married, and that Kate had reprogrammed him and sent him back in time after it had succeeded in killing John in 2032.
